name: Palaroccia Napoli
research_notes: Own home page (read 2026-10-06): "300mq di parete scalabile", "Campus board da 6m x 4m", "+2500 prese totali per un centinaio di blocchi adatti ad ogni difficolta" (blocchi = boulder problems), weekly hours (Mon/Wed/Fri 15-22, Tue/Thu 10-22, Sat 10-20), single entry 17 EUR non-members / 12 EUR members, rope/grigri rental (so a rope offer exists, but top-rope vs lead is not stated, so only indoor-bouldering is typed). Operator of the historic DEMON Rock Wall; the site says Palaroccia contains DEMON Rock Wall in a bigger space (opened June 2021 per UISP Zona Flegrea). The first pass (2026-10-05) read the same site but missed the "blocchi" line. Pin: OSM node on Via Viticella; the gym own Google embed (Via Viticella 98) sits about 130 m west, same street.

Own courses page: "Corso Base Arrampicata Indoor - Boulder ... provare tutti i boulder a disposizione" and a training course on "circuiti/giri e boulder di diverse difficolta". Facebook page "Eden Climbing" (name matches the site text and the edenclimbing@gmail.com contact; the site itself links the generic EdenParkZone page, not this one): "Eden Climbing e la nuova sala boulder dell Eden Park". Eden Park is a multi-sport venue run by an association (skate, parkour, acrobatics), hence category club; no rope offer is mentioned, only bouldering is typed. The first pass read the climbing page only and missed the courses page.

name: Free Climbing Palermo

research_notes: ASD with 25+ years in Palermo. Own site: "palestra boulder in indoor", activity "INDOOR CLIMBING - BOULDERING", "Climbing day: giornate di prova per principianti", gym hours Mon-Thu 19:30-22:00 (+ Thu 11-14 on request), Via Andrea Cirrincione 63. Own Instagram bio: "Palestra di arrampicata indoor - Bouldering, Palermo, Lun-Gio 19:30-22:00, Vieni a provare!". Own Facebook page description: "Indoor bouldering - Baby bouldering - Stage di arrampicata". No day-pass price is published; "Vieni a provare" and the trial days are the public-access statement. Pin is the gym own map link (east end of Via Cirrincione); house number 63 not confirmed on a map, so street-level.

name: Pozzuoli Boulder
address: Via Napoli (shore road towards Marinella), Pozzuoli
research_notes: NOT A GYM. falesia.it lists "Area Boulder: POZZUOLI BOULDER (NA)", updated 30/09/2023: large trachyte boulders on the shore of Via Napoli (fallen from Monte Olibano), 15 problems 4-6b+, access by a path next to the restaurant "la baia di marinella", problems opened by Simone Bonaccia and Gianluigi Schiavone (Vesuvio Extreme). The "Via Napoli 19" gym listing on palestralecolonne.it is an auto-generated directory entry (no phone, website, hours or reviews). No Instagram or Facebook page for a gym of this name exists (searched).

name: MAD Climbing Wall (Ex OPG Je so pazzo)

coord_source.ref: node 9200862471 "Ex OPG Occupato - Je so pazzo" (amenity=social_centre); the wall position inside the complex is not known

research_notes: Community wall inside the occupied social centre Ex OPG "Je so pazzo". Only source: an undated R-ange.it map entry (launched "dal 5 marzo", years ago): artificial wall 7.5 m x 4.5 m, vertical and overhanging, "boulder" with crash pads, free entry, Tue and Thu 20:00-21:30, courses by a FASI instructor. The centre own weekly schedule (jesopazzo.org, read 2026-10-06) lists calisthenics, boxing, kung fu, yoga, capoeira, etc. and NO climbing; its Facebook page (exopgjesopazzo) does not mention it in the preview text. Cannot tell whether the wall still operates.

research_notes: Older small wall (boulder wall 4.3 m, rope wall 4.5 m per directories) inside the Palasport Trincone.
